snippet.title: Super Orbmaster SAGE 26 DEMO TRAILER
snippet.description:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/super-orbmaster-sage-26-demo.3069/

music by: @Yiannudev 
made for: @SAGExpo 

Here is a secret project I've been working on for quite some time. Super Orbmaster is the culmination of what started out as a simple idea in a private gamejam that i took waaayyyy too far. If you liked this demo, then don't worry as there's way more where that came from. No idea when the full game will release, (or even if I'll finish it lol) as I'm pretty busy with IRL stuff but I'm like 90% sure there will be more demos at least.

#SAGE2026 #SAGEXPO
